name: creative-hover-card
title: Creative Hover Card
description: A row of three dark feature cards, each with a coloured tag, a heading, a short line of copy and a photo that fades to a second image on hover while the title and tag change.
use: A features row should feel alive and show more depth on hover without opening a modal.
avoid: Every meaningful change happens on hover, so touch and keyboard users only ever see the resting cards.
a11y: All changes require hover on non-focusable divs, so keyboard users get none of it, and alt text repeats 'Card image 01'. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three dark, rounded cards sit side by side on black. Each opens with a small coloured pill tag, then a bold pale heading, a line or two of grey copy and a wide photo filling the lower half, all softly bordered.
behaves: Hovering a card flips its tag to a new colour, swaps the heading for alternate wording and cross-fades the photo to a different image while nudging it up a few pixels. Each card changes on its own.
customise: The three cards, their copy, images and colours are all written inline; adapting them means editing each card's markup. No props.
weight: light: Six images and CSS opacity and transform transitions; nothing runs until hover.
